+import itertools
+import heapq
+
+
+def _interval_solver(capacity, tie):
+    def solve(data):
+        jobs = data["jobs"]
+        k = data["k"]
+        blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+        if mandatory & blocked or len(mandatory) > k:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+        best = None
+        best_value = None
+        eligible = [j for j in jobs if j["id"] not in blocked]
+        for subset in itertools.combinations(eligible, k):
+            ids = {j["id"] for j in subset}
+            if not mandatory <= ids:
+                continue
+            counts = {}
+            for job in subset:
+                group = job["group"]
+                counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+            if any(not (lo <= counts.get(group, 0) <= hi)
+                   for group, (lo, hi) in quotas.items()):
+                continue
+            active = []
+            valid = True
+            for job in sorted(subset, key=lambda x: (x["start"], x["end"])):
+                while active and active[0] <= job["start"]:
+                    heapq.heappop(active)
+                heapq.heappush(active, job["end"])
+                if len(active) > capacity:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+            selected = sorted(ids)
+            value = sum(j["value"] for j in subset)
+            if (best is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and
+                 ((selected > best) if tie == "largest" else (selected < best)))):
+                best, best_value = selected, value
+        if best is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": best, "value": best_value}
+    return solve
+

+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        names = sorted(packages, reverse=True)
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        roots = data["roots"]
+        best_vector = None
+        best_selection = None
+
+        def search(selection, constraints):
+            nonlocal best_vector, best_selection
+            # Validate all currently selected versions against every accumulated bound.
+            for name, version in selection.items():
+                if any(not (lo <= version <= hi) for lo, hi in constraints.get(name, [])):
+                    return
+            unresolved = next((n for n in names if n in constraints and n not in selection), None)
+            if unresolved is None:
+                # The constraints represent exactly the dependency closure.
+                if best_vector is None:
+                    vector = tuple(selection.get(n, -1) for n in names)
+                    best_vector, best_selection = vector, dict(selection)
+                else:
+                    vector = tuple(selection.get(n, -1) for n in names)
+                    if vector > best_vector:
+                        best_vector, best_selection = vector, dict(selection)
+                return
+            ranges = constraints[unresolved]
+            rows = []
+            for row in packages[unresolved]:
+                version = row["version"]
+                if version in blocked.get(unresolved, []):
+                    continue
+                if unresolved in pins and pins[unresolved] != version:
+                    continue
+                if all(lo <= version <= hi for lo, hi in ranges):
+                    rows.append(row)
+            # Descending is useful but exhaustive search preserves global objective.
+            for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r["version"], reverse=True):
+                version = row["version"]
+                new_sel = dict(selection)
+                new_sel[unresolved] = version
+                new_constraints = {n: list(v) for n, v in constraints.items()}
+                valid = True
+                for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                    feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                    if feature and feature not in features:
+                        continue
+                    target = dep["name"]
+                    new_constraints.setdefault(target, []).append((dep["min"], dep["max"]))
+                    if target in new_sel and not all(lo <= new_sel[target] <= hi
+                                                      for lo, hi in new_constraints[target]):
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                if not valid:
+                    continue
+                # Any cycle in the currently selected active edges invalidates this branch.
+                edges = {}
+                for source, source_version in new_sel.items():
+                    source_row = next(r for r in packages[source] if r["version"] == source_version)
+                    edges[source] = []
+                    for dep in source_row.get("deps", []):
+                        f = dep.get("feature", "")
+                        if (not f or f in features) and dep["name"] in new_sel:
+                            edges[source].append(dep["name"])
+                state, done = set(), set()
+                def visit(node):
+                    if node in state:
+                        return False
+                    if node in done:
+                        return True
+                    state.add(node)
+                    if any(not visit(child) for child in edges.get(node, [])):
+                        return False
+                    state.remove(node)
+                    done.add(node)
+                    return True
+                if not all(visit(node) for node in edges):
+                    continue
+                search(new_sel, new_constraints)
+
+        initial = {name: [(bounds[0], bounds[1])] for name, bounds in roots.items()}
+        if not initial:
+            return {"versions": {}}
+        search({}, initial)
+        if best_selection is None:
+            return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+        return {"versions": best_selection}
     return solve
